description:
You are responsible to migrate large data sets that resides on Oracle/MySQL to MongoDB and  
 write efficient and complex SQL queries/procedures against them to support the BI initiative of the organization.  
 - You are responsible to drive architectures, patterns and strategies for making the best use of MongoDB. 
 - Develop configure and tune MapReduce programs to run on large clusters. 

 

  Experience designing and developing applications on any industry leading RDBMS. 
 - Strong, hands-on experience writing SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and triggers. 
 - B.A. / B.S. or equivalent work experience 
 - Experience with scalable and highly available distributed systems  
 - Excellent presentation and communication skills
